description:
Hamsters become perfect office workers ! A research institute where a secret project to turn animals into perfect humans is underway. Hamsters Dali and Sammy merge to hide their shortcomings and participate in the project as a new employee, Ongdalsam. Will Ongdalsam be able to win the project without his identity being discovered ?!

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=837816), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12450052)
